reran: cmd.sh on the integration build, the base and 2.13.18: double definition error between m(p: Int, q: => Long) and m(p: Int, q: () => Long), as recorded; 2.12.20 the same. Scala 3.7.4 compiles it and prints 2. Variants: with q: () => A instead of by-name it compiles; with A also in a by-value parameter (m(p: A, q: => A)) it compiles and runs correctly.
user_impact: An override, in a class that fixes a specialized type parameter, of a method in which that parameter occurs only under by-name parameters is rejected. The same cause crashes the compiler on a plain declaration (see GE8): trait M[@specialized(Int) K, @specialized(Int) V] { def getOrElseUpdate(k: K, default: => V): Unit } fails an assertion in specialize on the integration build. A specialized map or cache with a by-name default is ordinary code, so the root cause rates higher than this rejection alone would.
fixability: clear cut: specializedTypeVars(sym) reads the method's info entering typer, where a by-name parameter is a reference to <byname>[T], whose type parameter is not @specialized, so T is not counted; other places read the info at specialize, after uncurry, where the parameter is Function0[T] and T is counted. Names and special overrides are then derived from two different sets. Count T under a by-name parameter in specializedTypeVarsBuffer, as Function0 will be. Cost: methods whose only use of the type parameter is by-name gain specialized variants (more members in specialized classes, a binary-compatible addition); programs affected do not compile today.
regression: no (2.12.20 rejects it the same way)
links: GE8 has the same root cause and should be fixed and tested with this one. scala/bug#3424 and #3433 are closed double-definition tickets with other causes.
note: The finding attributes the clash to the forwarder and the user method both erasing to Function0, which is the symptom; the cause is that the special override is given the unsuffixed name m because the name is computed from the pre-uncurry type variables (empty) while the decision to create it is made from the post-uncurry type. Rated high because it is the primary for GE8's crash; taken alone it is a medium wrong rejection. That one change fixes both was established by reading the code, not by building a fix. No scala/bug ticket found.
